verdict.label: Steady market
verdict.headline: Card prices are steady: no strong move either way right now.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 80.0 (+2.2% in a day) and momentum is 46: prices are steady. 84s cost 1,000, 85s 2,000 and 86s 5,500. Champions weekend starts Friday, when demand for meta cards usually peaks.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-11-19T06:01:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Sell Patri Guijarro 88 after its 32% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 46,000 coins. Now 46,000. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 31.9% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 13 of 20 so far, averaging +8.7% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Sell Luis Díaz 89 Team of the week after its 33% jump, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 205,000 coins. Now 150,000. Sell the spike: a card that jumped in a day often gives part of the jump back within two days. Picked because it is up 33.1% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 5 of 10 so far, averaging +4.4% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Buy cards you want for Champions before Friday evening
moves.detail: Demand for meta cards usually peaks when Champions weekend starts, so buying the cards you will play earlier is usually cheaper.

moves.title: Fodder: 85s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 1,000 (1.20 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,000 (0.95 coins per Item Score point), 86s 5,500 (1.34 coins per Item Score point), 87s 7,000 (1.27 coins per Item Score point), 88s 12,250 (1.48 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 85s then 84s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Louisa Necib and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Louisa Necib 87 Base Hero -36.7%; Paula Perea 75 Rare -34.4%; Sandra Villafañe 76 Rare -31.8%; Louisa Necib 87 Base Hero -30.4%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.
